When expected_receipt is absent, no observed invariant proves that the complete container bytes are the unique canonical bytes emitted by the builder. A ZIP carrying the same admitted members plus otherwise tolerated container-level/trailing bytes may therefore be structurally accepted while differing from canonical archive bytes.
counterhypothesis: Python zipfile parsing plus the current member/metadata checks may already reject every materially relevant noncanonical byte-level variant, so a canonical full-byte round-trip check could be redundant.
cheapest_discriminator: Take a canonical archive produced by build_release_archive, append non-empty trailing bytes after the end-of-central-directory record, and call verify_release_archive without expected_receipt. If verification succeeds, the verifier admits noncanonical whole-container bytes and the finding is confirmed. If it fails for an invariant already present, record the falsifier as closed without code change.
